subject: CAIQ: variant control matrix + evidence pulldown for Marketplace onboarding
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@marketplacecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: variant control matrix + evidence pulldown for Marketplace onboarding

Samantha —

Thanks again for the quick call last week. Per your onboarding checklist, attached is an initial "variant control matrix" that maps CAIQ questions to the runtime artifacts we typically provide (telemetry samples, KMS attestations, keystore rotation snippets, tenant isolation diagrams). The goal here is to give your intake team a concise pulldown of acceptable evidence types per control so the Marketplace portal can ingest and validate the package automatically.

Highlights in this draft (RDW_CAIQ_variant_matrix_v1.xlsx):
- Column A: CAIQ control id / short text
- Column B: Redwood assertion (short)
- Column C: Candidate evidence types (log excerpt, architecture diagram, signed attestation, doc sign link)
- Column D: Expected TTL / retention window for the artifact
- Column E: Evidence owner at Redwood (ops/product)

Two clarifying asks from our side:
1) Tenant scope exceptions — will the Marketplace accept per-tenant sampled artifacts (e.g., 1-week KV cache trace) in lieu of full-system dumps for controls around caching and telemetry?
2) Evidence format — can the intake accept ZIP manifests with a JSON index (we've attached an evidence_manifest_preview.zip as an example)?

Attached: RDW_CAIQ_variant_matrix_v1.xlsx, evidence_manifest_preview.zip, KMS_key_rotation_snippet.txt (example redacted).

If that format looks OK, we'd like to:
- Finalize the matrix by EOD Wednesday 6/6,
- Submit a compact evidence bundle to your intake for a dry run by 6/8.

Next steps we propose: short 30-min alignment call with your intake and technical reviewer (suggested attendees: Kimberly, Marissa, Priyom, Samantha, your security lead).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDW_CAIQ_variant_matrix_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: evidence_manifest_preview.zip (zip)]
[Attachment: KMS_key_rotation_snippet.txt (txt)]

From: Samantha Li <samantha@marketplacecloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: onboarding@marketplacecloud.com
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: variant control matrix + evidence pulldown for Marketplace onboarding

Kimberly —

Appreciate the matrix and the clear provenance on owners — this is exactly the kind of structured input our intake prefers. A couple of quick notes from the Marketplace side:

- Tenant-sampled artifacts are acceptable for telemetry and KV cache traces, provided they include the sampling methodology and an assertion that production is consistent with the sample window.
- We support ZIP manifests with a top-level index.json that lists file checksums; our ingestion will accept that pattern.
- For KMS / key rotation artifacts, we need a signed attestation from your security officer plus a snippet as you provided (redacted is fine) — the signed attestation can be a PDF.

Two asks for you:
1) Can you add a small column that indicates whether an artifact is suitable for automated validation vs manual review? That will help our portal route items.
2) Please include a link to the DocuSign for the marketplace security attestation (legal requires the attestation before we mark controls as closed).

I've looped in onboarding@marketplacecloud.com who will propose available times for the call — they appear available Wednesday afternoon PT or Thursday morning.

Samantha Li
Marketplace Onboarding Lead
MarketPlace Cloud Inc.

> Samantha —
>

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha@marketplacecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: variant control matrix + evidence pulldown for Marketplace onboarding

Kim / Priyom / Samantha —

I've reviewed the matrix and added two internal columns in the attached (version on our Drive):
- "Validation mode" = automated | manual
- "Sample rationale" = brief note on why a sample is representative (e.g., 7-day window, traffic parity, regional slice)

Priyom — can you confirm who owns the KMS signed attestation? I can draft the attestation language if you want; we'll need security sign-off anyway.

Also capturing the ingestion requirements Samantha listed — the index.json + checksum approach is implemented by our artifacts service (I've put a short README in the Drive folder).

Samantha — we've got the HubSpot deal (RDW-9842) in the handoff stage; adding you there so legal can track when we complete the attestation step.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bCk_caiq-evidence-snapshots]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Li <samantha@marketplacecloud.com>, legal@marketplacecloud.com
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: variant control matrix + evidence pulldown for Marketplace onboarding

All —

Thanks for the quick turn, team. Confirming action items and owners: 

- Marissa: finalize the matrix with the "Validation mode" and "Sample rationale" columns (target: EOD 6/6). Please attach the updated spreadsheet to the Drive folder and ping Samantha when done.
- Priyom: produce the signed KMS attestation draft (we'll route to Security for signature). Please include the rotation cadence and the last rotation date in the attestation (example in KMS_key_rotation_snippet.txt). Target: 6/6 morning.
- Legal & Marketplace: Samantha / legal@marketplacecloud.com: please share the DocuSign template for the security attestation or confirm if Marketplace will accept our internal PDF + signature.
- Kimberly: I'll submit the compact evidence bundle (ZIP with index.json + checksums) for a dry run once Marissa uploads the final matrix — plan is to submit 6/8 for portal ingestion test.

If there are any objections to the timeline call it out now; otherwise I'll schedule the 30-min alignment for Thursday 6/7 10:00 AM PT with onboarding.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Senior Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDW_CAIQ_variant_matrix_v1.xlsx (updated pending)]
